name: automation-tools
description: Manage prompt-based scheduled automation tasks and automation run history through AI-callable tools.
description_cn: 让 AI 可以管理基于提示词、引用能力和 Agent 的定时自动化任务与执行历史。
workflow: List tasks first when the current automation state is unclear.
Create or update tasks with prompt, skill_names, and agent_profile_id.
Ask for approval before deleting or running a task.
